description: Exact effective formulas of the dark-sector analysis of dirac16complex (SPEC sections 8, 11), derived by Revision/dark_sector/dirac16complex/derive/derive_effective.py (sympy); every entry is a named check of reports/derivation-checks.json.
coordinates: x1, x2, x3 = 3-space (scale factor e^{a4} sin^{1/6} z); x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the three exponentially DEFLATING extra times (time-like, scale factor e^{-a4} sin^{1/6} z, a4 increasing); x8 = hidden direction, z = 6 H x8 in (0, pi/2), y = ln(sin z)/(6 H).
observerScaleFactor: a = e^{a4} (3-space scale factor on the brane z = pi/2, normalised a = 1 at the chosen 'today' a4 = a4_today, i.e. a = e^{a4 - a4_today})

conservation.x8: d p8/d x8 + 3 H cot z (2 p8 - p3 - p_t) = 0  <=>  p8_y + 6 H p8 = 3 H (p3 + p_t)
conservation.integrated: dE/d a4 = -3 (P3 - Pt), E = int rho sqrt|g| d^7x, P3 = int p3 sqrt|g| d^7x, Pt = int p_t sqrt|g| d^7x (fixed occupations / exact solutions)

rho4.A_compact_coordinate_period: ASSUMPTION: the extra times are compact with a fixed coordinate period (closed time-like directions); rho_4 = E/(proper 3-volume) ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.B_per_unit_extra_time_coordinate_volume: non-compact extra times; rho_4 = E/(proper 3-volume x extra-time coordinate volume) ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.C_per_unit_proper_7_volume: rho_4 = E/(proper 7-volume) x (constant) ~ E (equivalently per unit proper extra-time volume)

wEff.definition: w_eff = -1 - (1/3) d ln rho_4/d ln a

ratios.w8: P8/E (integrated); brane-local p3/rho etc. also reported

flatModeLabelled.status: flat (warp-free) limit, used for the sign structure and the limits only

cpl.convention: w(a) = w0 + wa (1 - a); thawing wa < 0, freezing wa > 0 (the formula decides)
cpl.tangent: w0 = w(1), wa = -dw/da at a = 1 = -dw/da4 at a4 = a4_today
